messages:
Lina Growth: Heads-up: we need a last-minute refresh for the webinar retargeting ads. Enrollment is lagging vs forecast. Can we tighten pacing and surface new creative by tomorrow morning?
Omar Paid: Yep. Which audience buckets? I can shorten lookback windows and reweight budgets.
Lina Growth: Focus: recent viewers (7d video viewers, watched >50%) and trial starters who didn't convert (14d). Pull 40% of prospecting budget into the retargeting cluster for 72h test.
Sophie Creative: I'll make two quick hero variants: 1) "See Redwood in action: 30-min webinar" (feature walkthrough) 2) "How we cut inference cost 3x" (case study). Short CTA and a secondary CTA for engineers: "API quickstart".
Derek Ops: Landing page note: LP-webinar-v3 has the event widget + anchor to docs. If we repurpose LP for trial CTAs, need to change the form hidden field: `utm_content=webinar_v3_refresh` and `variant=a|b`. I can deploy by 06:00 PT.
Omar Paid: Plan: set daily cap increase +30% for retargeting only, and enable a budget throttler rule: if CPA > $120 over 12h, pause and rollback. Also enable creative rotation evenly for first 48h.
Lina Growth: Good. Also add a second cohort: only-target people from our blog post about "inference optimization" in last 21d. Lower bid by 15% for that cohort (lower intent).
Sophie Creative: Quick copy snippets: 
```
Variant A: Save dev time & latency \u2014 join our 30-min demo. Register now.
Variant B: Learn how Acme reduced token costs by 3x with Redwood. Seats limited.
```
I'll include one small testimonial line: "Redwood cut our inference bill in half" \u2014 Dev Lead, Acme as a small blurb for B.
Omar Paid: UA settings: utm_campaign=web_may_refresh&utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_term={keyword}&utm_content={variant}. Tag conversions for webinar_register and trial_start.
ads-bot: Campaign "web_may_refresh" updated: retargeting budget +40% for 72h, creative rotation enabled, rule: pause if CPA > 120 USD (12h). Change executed at 06:00 PT.
Derek Ops: Deployed LP changes, QAed the form and anchors. Variant flags set: `variant=a` and `variant=b`.
Lina Growth: Metrics to watch: registration rate, webinar attendance rate, trial conversion within 7d, CPA. Ben (analytics) if you get this later, please add a short dashboard widget.
Sophie Creative: One more tiny test: switch hero image to a screenshot of the dashboard vs abstract cloud art. Should we A/B image too?
Omar Paid: Add image test but keep traffic weight small (10% each image). Throttler: if CTR drops by >25% on either image, pause that image.
Lina Growth: Timeline recap: creative + LP done by 06:00 PT, campaign changes live 06:15 PT, first checkpoint 12h, main review 72h. Thanks all. :pray:
